name: Witch Hunter: Unbroken grants 20% of maximum health attack power on the first hit and walks it down in tiers
contract: Unbroken 707407 is the passive Witch Hunter talent whose description reads 'Taking damage increases your attack
power, up to 20% of maximum health. Increased further against Demons and Undead. This degrades slowly over time,
and while out of combat.' Its three Spell.dbc effects are passive dummy auras (base 325/150/75, misc 5/10/20,
miscB 10/5/50) and its row carries ProcFlags 0, so the core generated no proc from it and no spell_proc row
existed: the talent granted no attack power at all.
The AP buff 707487 is a flat SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER (99, misc 1) with melee and ranged AP-versus
effects, so its amount is a flat attack power number, not a percentage. 20% of maximum health is therefore the
cap the amount is measured against, and the expected amount is a fraction of the holder's maximum health.
The misc 5/10/20 values are the decay tiers as percentages of that cap and miscB 10/5/50 the ticks each tier
holds for, so the expected behaviour is: the first qualifying taken hit sets the amount to the whole cap rather
than accumulating it, further hits hold it at the cap instead of exceeding it, and out of combat the amount
falls in that tier's percentage of the cap every that tier's ticks, so the walk down is independent of how much
health the character has. The buff is also reapplied with a 6 s duration on every tick, so it must still be
present long after the last qualifying hit instead of expiring.
A control of the same race, class and level without the passive takes the same kind of damage and must never
gain the buff. The decay walk is asserted as a fraction of maximum health because the cap is 20% of it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The talent grants the Unbroken passive
SETUP: the control has the same maximum health
SETUP: no attack power buff before taking damage
SETUP: the hunter's auto attacks land
DISCRIMINATING: the first hit taken already grants the whole 20% cap
The control gains no attack power buff while taking the same damage
Stay in combat so further procs land
Further procs hold the cap instead of exceeding it
SETUP: the enemy dies, so no further hit keeps the buff at the cap
The hunter leaves combat, so the decay can run
Pass the buff's own 6 s duration with no qualifying hit
The buff is still present past its duration, so every tick refreshes it
The first decay tier has not elapsed yet
The first tier drops the amount by 20% of the cap, to 16% of maximum health
The second tier drops it to 12% of maximum health
The walk down reaches zero and the buff is removed
